{{Quote|They don't like visitors unless you're an Imperial. Better than being a Nyax follower! Eh. May as well be the same thing.|[[Lock Vlash]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LV" />}}
The '''Cult of Lord Nyax''', also known as '''Lord Nyax's Cult''' or as the '''Followers of Nyax''', was a religion on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that worshiped the mythological character [[Lord Nyax]] and made several [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attacks in his name.

==Description==
{{Quote|In ancient times, on Corellia, Lord Nyax was what parents threatened their children with if they didn't eat their stewfruit or go to bed on time.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="EL2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Nyax_Cultist.jpg|thumb|left|A Nyax cultist.]]
The Followers of Nyax worshiped Lord Nyax, an ancient [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Ghost (folklore)|ghost]] whose name was invoked to scare children.<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> The Cult of Lord Nyax was a secretive and dreaded order. The Nyax cultists were dangerous fanatics who sought to terrorize the citizens of Corellia, following the example of Lord Nyax himself.<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> While Lord Nyax was only a mythological character, the Cult nonetheless was led by a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who referred to himself as [[Lord Nyax (cult leader)|Lord Nyax]].<ref name="SWG:LNC" />

According to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and to former Followers of Nyax, the Cult was secretly backed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:LV" /><ref name="SWG:PS" /> Indeed, the Cult hated the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and thus, when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] came to Corellia to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destroy]] the Jedi residing their, terrified citizens gave the name of Nyax to Vader himself. The Cult picked up on this, and believed Vader was in fact inhabited by the [[Force ghost/Legends|ghost]] of Nyax. This led the Followers of Nyax to treat Vader somewhat reverentially, and look to him as an inspiration to slaughter additional Jedi throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CDAG" /> Despite these notions, and the rumors of Imperial backing, the Cult of Nyax did not particularly identify with the Galactic Empire.<ref name="CDAG" /><ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|284|Followers of Nyax}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Ahh, the feared cult of Lord Nyax. Their hideout can be found on Corellia in the central region of the planet. Unfortunately, I have little information to give you about them other than the rumor that they are secretly backed by the Empire.|[[Pashna Starkiller (Mon Calamari)|Pashna Starkiller]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:PS" />}}
[[File:LordNyax.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The leader of the Cult, who referred to himself as [[Lord Nyax (cult leader)|Lord Nyax]].]]
The Cult of Lord Nyax was formed years prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As the Cult had grown in power, it emerged as a source of trouble for the [[Corellian Security Force]]. During numerous years, the Corsec had adopted a policy of containment rather than destruction.<ref name="SWG:LNC" /> However, after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Cult of Nyax was in open conflict with CorSec and its mercenaries allies of [[Beldonna's League]].<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref>

During the time of the Galactic Civil War, the Cult of Lord Nyax operated out of a [[Lord Nyax's Cult hideout|hideout]] in the [[Riverlands]] region of Corellia.<ref name="SWG:LNC" /> After the Battle of Yavin, the Follower of Nyax [[Lock Vlash]] managed to escape the Cult. Vlash remained worried that some cultists could try to take revenge on him, especially after he tried to sell the location of the Lord Nyax's Cult hideout.<ref name="SWG:LV" />
